item.tib: stag gzig yul gyi mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung mi bcag phyir/ rang sems mi 'gyur dpang du btsug lung la chad bslad med par bris/ 'gal 'khrul bla ma rje la bshag yi dam lha la bzod pa gsol/ ma sring gnyen la mthol lo bshag bka' srung rko long mi mdzad zhu/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ dus gsum pha mas gtsor byas pa'i/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ dag pa'i gnas mchog 'ol mo gling / bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ 'chi med gshen gyi sa thob shog kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bsgrab rgyud bstan pa dar ba dang / lam bar chod med par mthar phyin nas/ bka' brgyud bstan pa mi nub nyi ma'i zer/ don phyogs bcu kun tu dar rgyas nas/ mtha' nam mkha' ci bzhin bkra shis shog/
